notes: Slayer as host rules: game modes (Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch and modes other Add-Ons add, such as Capture the Flag), lives, points and time to win, rounds that end with the winner announced and reset after the time between rounds, the pre-round countdown with its voice and buzzer and players frozen in place, and teams that sort, balance and spawn on their own team spawns, with friendly fire off by default and team chat. Capture points (the 8x8 and 16x16 Capture Point bricks) fill a bar for a team standing on them, ease back when they leave, and turn to the capturing team's colour, with points for the capture and the onCPCapture, onCPCapture(TeamN) and onCPReset brick events. Players out of lives spectate five seconds after their last death: orbiting the living players and the capture points (fire and jet step through them), a free camera, or the auto camera gliding past each player at a wide angle, with jump or the light key changing the mode and Team-Only DeadCam, Enable Auto-Camera Mode and Spectate Capture Points in the settings. The fly-through camera works too: /createFlyCam, /setKnot, /setJump, /testFlyCam and /deleteFlyCam lay and try a path that flies every member before the round (Play At Beginning of Round, Countdown During Fly-Thru, Rounds Between Fly-Thrus). Its settings are in the Mini-Game window's Add-On Settings, beside the vanilla mini-game settings Slayer also edited; /teams and /slayer work as in Slayer. Builders' wrench has Slayer's event outputs: setTeamControl (a team spawn or capture point to a team's colour), setTeamControlLocked (lock a capture point for the team that set it off, a colour or everyone), addLives, addKills, addDeaths and their set forms, joinTeam, incTimeRemaining, setTimeRemaining, Win (the player, their team, a named player or team, any text, or nobody), StartFlyThrough (the mini-game's creator), and checkTeam and checkTeamCount with onTeamCheckTrue and onTeamCheckFalse (a row range like "1 4" limits which rows run), and Slayer counts kills and deaths (Clear Stats on Reset). Rows can aim at Team(Client), whoever set the row off's team, and Team(Brick), the teams of the colour holding the brick, to message (ChatMsgAll, CenterPrintAll, BottomPrintAll, with %1 as the player's name), respawn (RespawnAll) or score (IncScore, the team's own points toward the points to win) the whole team. A player on a team also sets off onPlayerTouch(TeamN) and onActivate(TeamN) for their team's place in the list, and every brick of the game hears onMinigameDeath (the client who died, with Player(Killer) and Client(Killer)), onMinigameJoin, onMinigameLeave, onMinigameRoundStart and onMinigameRoundEnd. With Restrict Output Events on (Events in the settings), a player in the game adds Slayer's mini-game and team outputs only if they may edit the game, and the copy's admin-only ones only as an admin; a refused row is left out and they are told why. Each team dresses its members by its Uniform (None, Shirt Only in the team's colour, Full: a cop hat and plain clothes in the team's colour with a random skin colour, or Custom, the team's Uniform settings part by part with TEAMCOLOR for its colour; Allow Custom Face Decals keeps players' own faces) and gives them its Playertype, Start Equip 0 to 4 (unless Sync w/ Minigame Loadout keeps the game's), Player Scale and Respawn Time; changes reach players at once, a new start tool only where they still carry the old one. Not ported yet: team captains, uniforms on player types with their own model, friendly-fire penalties, team swaps, the end of round report, bots, the advanced-only Slayer_setPref output, and keeping a fly-through path with saved mini-game settings (.pathcam).
